record.title: Nouns Cola operating board
record.dek: Formulation, fundraising, contribution lanes, inventory financing, production, profit, and surplus yield for a PointCast pilot.
record.body:
Nouns Cola now has a PointCast operating page. It is not just a splash page: the board lays out the Formula 01 targets, the fundraising uses, the contribution lanes, the inventory financing draft, the co-packer production sequence, and a live profit/yield calculator for the pilot run.

The useful move is visibility. If the can works, everyone can see the assumptions before the pallet ships: cases, direct sell-through, wholesale price, production cost, fixed launch spend, raise gap, profit, and the surplus pool.

The new financing plan separates help from float. Taste panels, case preorders, crate sponsors, retail doors, and pallet sponsors are product/community contributions. Any inventory facility is a separate draft plan that requires formula lock, co-packer quote, label review, purchase-order packet, and counsel approval before it becomes real.

Yield here means operating surplus routing, not an investment promise: refill production, fund the PointCast treasury, grow the drop, and bonus the team. Go team.
